Karthik / Hannah — I've pulled traces and raw telemetry for Velvet Commerce using the request IDs Lena provided. TL;DR: confirmed an elevated error rate impacting checkout.v1/complete from 2026-07-12T15:49:00Z to 2026-07-12T15:09:00Z (UTC) — corresponds to ~08:49–09:09 PDT in their timeline.

Preliminary findings (short):
- Root cause: a mis-routed autoscaler rollout caused a subset of routing proxies to drop to a degraded path under load; this led to request amplification and a cascade of 429s on the upstream inference cluster.
- Scope: errors localized to the us-west region and affected ~5% of checkout traffic for Velvet during the window; other tenants saw transient upticks but Velvet hit the worst of it due to traffic patterns.
- Evidence: attached trace-bundle-velvet.tar.gz contains span traces and request-level errors.

Proposed next steps:
1) Provide Velvet with the confirmed UTC window and the attached trace bundle.
2) Offer one of the following remedies (recommendation in bold):
   - prorated service credit for the impacted interval (standard SLA path)
   - one-time invoice credit equal to the calculated revenue impact (business remediation)
   - technical remediation + elevated support package for the next 30 days (no credit)

Recommendation: prorated SLA credit is the correct contractual starting point; escalate to finance for a one-time invoice credit only if Velvet requests an immediate cash remediation. I'll draft the technical RCA; target delivery 2026-07-19 EOD.

Attachments: [Attachment: trace-bundle-velvet.tar.gz (application/gzip)]

Let me know if you want me to share the bundle directly to Lena (I can scrub sensitive internal IDs), or if you prefer we summarize and send a redacted package.
